candidates.statement: BCG 1 BCG vaccination is recommended for unvaccinated TST- or IGRA-negative persons at risk of occupational exposure in low and high TB incidence areas (e.g. health- care workers, laboratory workers, medical students, prison workers, other individuals with occupational exposure).
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Polio 3 All HCWs should have completed a full course of primary vaccination against polio.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: All health-care workers should up to date with immunization as recommended in their national immunization schedules.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Measles 5 All HCWs should be immune to measles and proof/documentation of immunity or immunization should be required as a condition of enrollment into training and employment.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Rubella 6 If rubella vaccine has been introduced into the national programme, all HCWs should be immune to rubella and proof/documentation of immunity or immunization should be required as a condition of enrollment into training and employment.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Meningococcal 7 One booster dose 3-5 years after the primary dose may be given to persons considered to be at continued risk of exposure, including HCWs.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Annual immunization with a single dose is recommended.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Varicella 9 Countries should consider vaccination of potentially susceptible health-care workers (i.e. unvaccinated and with no history of varicella) with 2 doses of varicella vaccine.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Pertussis 10 HWCs should be prioritized as a group to receive pertussis vaccine.
candidates.section_title: Vaccination of Health Care Workers Recommended

candidates.statement: Tetanus 11 There is currently no recommendation regarding HCWs.
